description: Provenance for the XCCDF 1.2 schema (NIST SCAP) and the schemas it imports, vendored byte for byte (#1354). XccdfSchema points each import's schemaLocation at the copies here when it loads them, in memory, so the files stay verbatim and validation never reaches the network.
verified: 2026-11-20. Fetched from the publishers below. Compared with the copies OpenSCAP ships (github.com/OpenSCAP/openscap, schemas/): the content matches except where OpenSCAP edited its copies (local import paths, processContents="lax" on the Dublin Core metadata element, a widened CPE name pattern) and ships an older xml.xsd. The NIST originals are kept.
license_basis: NIST publications are works of the United States Government (17 U.S.C. 105). xml.xsd is published by the W3C for use under its document license.
re_vendor: Fetch every file from its source_url, replace it verbatim, and update this sidecar. Any new import gets an entry in imports, or loading fails.
